name: Gleaming Plate
description: Lay a bright plate of qi over the front that throws a glancing strike off in a flash of light.

name: Level Press
description: Press the flat of the plate level into the opponent's guard to lean the opponent off balance.

name: Paired Sidestep
description: Step aside in matched time with a partner so the two plates stay edge to edge.

name: Hawk Rebuke
description: Turn the plate on an incoming blow and return its force at the attacker's lead shoulder.

name: Twin Lock
description: Close both plates over an opponent's weapon hand and lock the grip so the weapon cannot be raised.

name: Mending Hand
description: Rest a hand of mending qi on a wounded ally and close the wound under the shelter of the plate.

name: Stalwart Aegis
description: Stand beneath a thick aegis that does not waver under a long sustained press from several strikers.

name: Pressing Swell
description: Push the stored weight of the plates outward in a broad wave that throws back the attackers around the user.

name: Sovereign Mantle
description: Cast a mantle over each ally in the qi field that cuts the force of every blow to them by the user's own ward.

name: Warden Plate
description: Raise a plain plate at the ward's forefront with the warden's weight set behind it.

name: Warded Draw
description: Pull the warded person behind the user with a strand of qi and step into the vacated place.

name: Plate Murmur
description: Hear a low murmur in the plate that rises with the strength of whatever gathers to strike the warded person.

name: Backhand Brace
description: Set a flat hand to the warded person's back and take the weight of a blow through the warden's arm.

name: Hushing Palm
description: Press a hushing palm to an opponent's chest and damp the opponent's qi for the length of a few breaths.

name: Closing Grasp
description: Close a hand of qi round an attacker's wrist and hold the arm still against the ward.

name: Echo Aegis
description: Take a blow into the aegis and send an echo of equal weight back along the line of the strike.

name: Warden Aegis
description: Hold a full aegis over the warded person while the warden advances on the aggressor.

name: Shattering Pulse
description: Send a hard pulse of stored ward qi through the palm to shatter an attacker's raised guard.

name: Absolute Calm
description: Fold a field of perfect quiet round the warded person that cancels one incoming force outright before it lands.

name: Hawk Mantle
description: Spread a mantle of qi from the shoulders like folded wings to take a blow from the front.

name: Brood Cover
description: Spread both wings of the ward wide to cover the small company gathered close behind the user.

name: Pinion Turn
description: Beat one wing of the ward sideways and sweep an incoming thrust out past the user.

name: Wing Beat
description: Beat both wings of the ward forward to buffet an attacker and drive the attacker back.

name: Wingtip Feel
description: Feel at the wingtips of the ward for any blow that gathers at the field's edge.

name: Wing Folded
description: Fold the wings inward around a heavy blow and let the feathers of qi soak the shock.

name: Wing Lending
description: Lend one wing of the ward to an ally and keep it fed until the ally's own guard is strong again.

name: Feather Cleanse
description: Brush the ward lightly over an ally and sweep poison and taint out of the skin like dust.

name: Spread Pinion
description: Spread the full pinion over the brood and hold it steady against blows from the front and from above.

name: Plunging Rebuke
description: Drop the pinion edge-first onto an attacker who has overreached and strike through the opponent's guard.

name: Wheeling Rebuke
description: Wheel the whole pinion to catch a mighty strike and hurl its full force back at the one who loosed it.

name: Pooling Ward
description: Let the ward pool qi at the point of the coming blow until it is thick enough to hold.

name: Rill Turn
description: Send a thin stream of the ward round a thrust like a rill round a stone and carry it past.

name: Silted Hold
description: Let the ward thicken like settled silt so a heavy blow sinks into it and stops.

name: Spate Pace
description: Rush a pace forward on the swell of an enemy's blow and leave the ward behind as a screen.

name: Banked Strike
description: Release the qi banked behind the ward in one short strike at the opponent's belly.

name: Shock Gathering
description: Draw the shock of a blow into the ward like water into a basin and hold it there until it can be let go.

name: Runoff Return
description: Let the stored shock run off the ward in one pulse back at the one who struck.

name: Clearing Wash
description: Wash poison and taint from an ally's blood with a slow clear stream of qi drawn through the ward.

name: Silting Seal
description: Thicken the air about an opponent's feet like silt and seal the opponent's stance in place.

name: Overflow Aegis
description: Hold an aegis so full of stored qi that the surplus spills out and thickens the ward of each ally nearby.

name: Cresting Surge
description: Raise the stored ward in a tall crest and let it break outward over every attacker at the front.

name: Deep Stillness
description: Sink the whole ward to a deep still calm into which a mighty blow falls and is cancelled without a ripple.

name: Crowned Plate
description: Set a crowned rim round the plate of qi so that its edge turns a cutting blow.

name: Linked Stride
description: Take a stride beside a partner while the two plates stay linked and cover the same ground.

name: Mirrored Cover
description: Mirror the partner's slant so a blow glancing off one plate is caught on the other and turned again.

name: Counter Brace
description: Brace against the partner's back and let the shock of a hit pass through both bodies and into the ground.

name: Joint Sense
description: Feel through both plates at once and know where either partner is hardest pressed.

name: Sovereign Lending
description: Pass a share of the user's own sovereign ward to the partner and keep it flowing through the exchange.

name: Double Rebuke
description: Return a heavy blow from both plates at once so the force is doubled on its way back.

name: Pairing Mend
description: Heal a wounded partner by joining both plates round the wound and mending it with joint qi.

name: Binding Pair
description: Bind an attacker between the two plates as between jaws and hold the attacker fast.

name: Regal Aegis
description: Hold a regal aegis of unbroken surface over the pair and keep it through long hard fighting.

name: Crowning Surge
description: Throw the pair's joined ward outward in a ring that flings off every attacker and breaks their formation.

name: Stilling Hand
description: Lay a stilling hand on a charging opponent and drain the force from the charge in an instant.

name: Supreme Aegis
description: Raise over the whole company a sovereign ward that cannot be broken by any force below the user's own grade.

name: Pinion Plate
description: Shape the plate into a broad pinion that sheds a blow along its feathered edge.

name: Tucked Pinion
description: Tuck the pinion against the flank and flick it out to turn a stab aside.

name: Lofting Pace
description: Rise a pace on the lift of the pinion and settle beside an ally in danger.

name: Airy Feel
description: Feel the lightest stir of qi against the pinion's vane and read an attack before it is made.

name: Spreading Wing
description: Spread the wing in a single sweep to cover three allies in the path of a blow.

name: Wing Mend
description: Fold the wing round a hurt ally and mend torn flesh and bruised bone with warmth held inside it.

name: Pinion Snap
description: Snap the hard edge of the pinion into an opponent's forearm and knock the weapon from the grip.

name: Broad Pinion
description: Hold the pinion wide open for a long exchange so it covers a half circle round the user.

name: Seamless Fold
description: Fold the wing round a heavy blow in a single motion that leaves no seam for the force to find.

name: Peerless Cover
description: Sweep the full pinion across a mighty strike so that it is carried clear of the user and every ally behind.

name: Warden Gust
description: Whip a ring of wind-driven qi round the body so that blows slide aside before they touch.

name: Oath Glance
description: Give a thrown weapon a glancing touch with the ward and let the oath carry it past the sworn.

name: Wind Pace
description: Ride a gust to the side of a sworn ally in danger and raise the ward as the feet land.

name: Leaning Hold
description: Lean into the blow with the whole ward and let it spend itself against the yielding weight of the wind.

name: Gale Shove
description: Shove an opponent back with a hard gust from the face of the ward.

name: Oath Lending
description: Lend a measure of the warden's ward to a sworn ally and keep it fed as long as the oath holds.

name: Gale Purifying
description: Drive a clean gale of qi through a sworn ally's body to carry off poison and taint.

name: Warden Rebuke
description: Catch a blow on the ward and fling it back along the wind at the one who struck.

name: Stormproof Aegis
description: Hold an aegis that grows stronger against each wave of blows and does not tire in the wind.

name: Scattering Gust
description: Loose the stored ward as a great gust that scatters the attackers round the user.

name: Oathbound Aegis
description: Bind the whole company's wards into one oath-held aegis that grows stronger over each member the longer all keep faith.

name: Ward Bar
description: Draw a line of ward across the path of the attack and hold it against the first blow.

name: Squared Plate
description: Square the plate to the oncoming blow so it meets the force full on its face.

name: Hard Bearing
description: Take a hard bearing against a heavy blow and let the legs carry its weight.

name: Bearing Tempo
description: Shift a pace along the line of the bearing without breaking the ward.

name: Strike Reading
description: Read the line of an attack from the pressure it lays along the ward.

name: Weight Taken
description: Take the full weight of a crushing blow into the stance and let it pass into the ground.

name: Stayed Rebuke
description: Hold the blow a heartbeat inside the ward and hurl it back with the held weight added.

name: Bearing Latch
description: Seal the line of the attack so that the striker's blow cannot cross the bearing at all.

name: Bearing Tending
description: Ease and mend an ally's crushed ribs and strained joints under the shelter of the held ward.

name: Unmoved Aegis
description: Hold an aegis that sets so firmly on the bearing that nothing but a breakthrough can shift it.

name: Staggering Return
description: Return a heavy blow through the aegis and stagger the striker so the striker's next stroke goes astray.

name: Adamant Bearing
description: Hold a bearing of adamant weight that swallows every blow on the line and gives not a pace.

name: Company Cover
description: Spread an open cover over each sworn ally standing within arm's reach of the user.

name: Proffered Hand
description: Offer an open hand to an ally and pass the ally a measure of the user's ward qi.

name: Company Pace
description: Move at the pace of the slowest sworn ally and keep the open ward whole over all.

name: Joint Mantle
description: Draw one mantle over the whole company and share its weight evenly among the sworn.

name: Open Tending
description: Mend each wounded ally within the open ward in turn and ease them back to fighting.

name: Breath Cleanse
description: Breathe clean qi over the company and clear poison and taint from their breath and blood.

name: Company Aegis
description: Hold a full aegis over the company that shifts its thick part toward whichever member is most pressed.

name: Gale Rebuke
description: Gather the blows on the open ward and fling them back across the field in a single gust.

name: Unfenced Oath
description: Swear one oath over the company that makes the open ward answer each sworn member's need at the instant it arises.

name: Unbarred Stand
description: Stand square with an open ward before the chest and ask no cover but the ward itself.

name: Wind Lean
description: Lean with the push of a blow like a stem in the wind and let it pass over the ward.

name: Level Feeling
description: Feel the level of the ground and the lean of the air for any blow approaching low.

name: Footing Shell
description: Plant the ward about the feet so the force of a blow runs down into the earth.

name: Bearing Gift
description: Give a bearing to an ally and a share of the ward that will keep the ally steady on it.

name: Rimless Screen
description: Hold a screen with no rim that yields at one edge and thickens at the other.

name: Gust Rebuke
description: Throw back an assault on the ward as a hard gust that bowls the striker over.

name: Standing Aegis
description: Stand in the open under an aegis that needs no wall and yields to nothing that leans on it.

name: Tempest Turn
description: Spin the aegis in a hard whirl and throw off a storm of blows from every side.

name: Sheer Bearing
description: Take a sheer bearing against a mighty blow and cancel it entirely against the warden's own stillness.

name: Gale Plate
description: Spin a plate of wind-bound qi in front of the chest that rings as a blow breaks across it.

name: Oath Surge
description: Surge forward on the oath behind a hardened plate and knock an attacker off the line.

name: Breeze Step
description: Slip a pace on a light breeze of qi and put the ward between an ally and the blow.

name: Sworn Hearing
description: Hear through the oath when a sworn ally is struck and learn which side that ally lies.

name: Lifting Hand
description: Lift a fallen ally and ease the shock of the fall with a breath of warm qi.

name: Gale Mantle
description: Cast a gale mantle over an ally that holds firm for as long as the ally keeps to the line.

name: Sworn Rebuke
description: Meet a blow on the sworn ward and send it back out along the wind.

name: Lashing Gust
description: Lash a hard gust across an opponent's wrists and break the rhythm of the opponent's attack.

name: Sworn Aegis
description: Hold a sworn aegis over the company that grows heavier on the side that faces the strongest blow.

name: Cleansing Gale
description: Send a clean gale through every sworn ally to carry out poison and taint and the weight of a curse.

name: Oathen Tempest
description: Pour the wards of all the sworn into one tempest that bursts over the attackers and clears the whole ground.

name: Final Plate
description: Lay down a plate that the warden means to hold to the last breath.

name: Oath Fold
description: Fold the ward tight about the sworn and take the blow upon the warden's own back.

name: Final Pace
description: Take the last step to the sworn ally's side and close the ward over the gap.

name: Vow Divining
description: Read from the oath how near death a sworn ally stands and how long the ward can hold.

name: Closing Vow
description: Speak the closing vow and turn a mortal blow from the sworn with a sweep of the ward.

name: Oath Riposte
description: Throw a blow against the sworn back at the one who loosed it with the oath's weight behind it.

name: Warden Seal
description: Seal the vow over an attacker so the attacker cannot strike the one the warden has sworn to guard.

name: Vow Lending
description: Lend the vow's strength to a failing ally and keep it flowing as long as the warden stands.

name: Oath Cleanse
description: Draw a curse or taint out of a sworn ally and let the oath burn it away.

name: Vow Aegis
description: Hold an aegis bound to the vow that tightens round the sworn as the fight grows hotter.

name: Vow Revive
description: Close the ward round a sworn ally whose heart has just stopped and drive it to beat again while the vow holds.

name: Final Vow
description: Swear the final vow and take on the warden's own ward every blow meant for the sworn until the warden falls.
